entities.name: Zoning Code
entities.description: The official set of rules and standards that govern land use, zoning districts, and development regulations within the city.

entities.name: Parking and Access
entities.description: Standards and provisions related to parking requirements, access, and related infrastructure for various land uses, including considerations for affordable housing near transit stops.

entities.name: Affordable Housing
entities.description: Housing units that are affordable to low- and moderate-income residents, often supported by city policies, incentives, or regulations to promote accessibility and affordability.

entities.name: Workforce Housing
entities.description: Housing designed to be affordable for essential city workers, including provisions for city-owned, financed, or operated facilities as part of zoning and land use regulations.

entities.name: Window and Hurricane Shutters
entities.description: Regulations governing the installation, closure, and operation of window and hurricane shutters to ensure safety and compliance with city standards.

entities.name: Signs for Sale, Lease or Rental
entities.description: Rules and standards for signage related to real estate transactions, including signs for sale, lease, or rental properties within the city.
